title: Polynomial construction with universal evaluation, before choosing parameters
statement: Let k be a field and A a finitely presented k-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. For natural numbers d and n with n ≥ 1, put R = k[X_i | i ∈ Fin d] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. There exist c ≥ 1, a finitely presented R-algebra C in universe max(u,v) with compatible k-algebra structure, and a k-algebra map β : A → C such that every image of X_i^c is strictly standard over R [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element]. These data are chosen before and independently of any receiving algebra. For every commutative k-algebra Λ, k-algebra map α : A → Λ, and evaluation φ : R → Λ such that φ(X_i)^n belongs to the extended singular ideal H_{A/k}Λ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal] for every i, there exists an R-algebra map γ : C → Λ with γβ = α and popescuIdeal α ≤ popescuIdeal γ [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution]. No regular-local, dimension, parameter-generation or annihilator assertion is part of this construction statement.

proof.text: Choose finite generators a_j of H_{A/k}. Construct B=A[x_i,z_ij]/(x_i^n−Σ_j z_ij a_j); its presentation over R is finite.

Eliminate z_il after inverting a_l. This exhibits B_(a_l) as a polynomial extension of the smooth base change of A_(a_l). After inverting x_i the a_j generate the unit ideal; smoothness on their principal cover proves B_(x_i) smooth. The empty generator family produces the zero localization.

Improve B to C with a B-algebra retraction. Its indicated localizations are smooth, and at the x_i their differentials are free. Noetherianity makes C finitely presented. Choose a common positive strictly-standard exponent c.

For any receiving algebra and evaluation with the required nth powers in the extended singular ideal, expand those powers in the images of the fixed generators a_j. Evaluate the Z_ij at their coefficients; the equations vanish and give B → Λ. Compose with the retraction C → B. Smoothness of C at each β(a_j) gives extension of H_{A/k} inside H_{C/R}. Map this inclusion to Λ and take radicals to obtain the Popescu-ideal inequality. The quotient and symmetric-algebra constructions remain in universe max(u,v).

theorem exists_popescu_separable_preparation_core
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [FinitePresentation k A] (d n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ (c : ℕ) (C : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra k C)
      (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C)
      (_ : FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C) (β : A →ₐ[k] C),
      1 ≤ c ∧
      (∀ i : Fin d, IsStrictlyStandardElement (R := MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C (MvPolynomial.X i ^ c))) ∧
      ∀ {Λ : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
        (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k →ₐ[k] Λ),
        letI := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
        (∀ i : Fin d, φ (MvPolynomial.X i) ^ n ∈
          Ideal.map α.toRingHom (singularIdeal k A)) →
        ∃ γ : C →ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin d) k] Λ,
          (γ.restrictScalars k).comp β = α ∧ popescuIdeal α ≤ popescuIdeal γ
